verdict.rationale: Community reports indicate Vue has explicit channels for data flow: child-to-parent updates go through `emit`, and the official Vuex store is described as a clean flux implementation. Vue's own docs, however, promote v-model two-way syncing, and users report confusion from implicit state changes and parents mutating child data. missing for 10: first-party documentation of one-way props-down/events-up data flow, documentation of Pinia/Vuex as traceable state management, state-change tracing or devtools evidence, and guidance avoiding implicit two-way bindings.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace state changes through explicit, predictable data flow instead of debugging implicit two-way bindings

citations.quote: emit requires explicitly re-emitting up each level
Vuex 2 is one of the cleanest flux implementations they've seen.
